title: When the Signal Falls
author: F. M. Lockridge
blurb: Edmund Winterbourne, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
